# GrowthTechSys

> GrowthTechSys is a specialized engineering firm and digital product studio building custom AI systems, workflow automation pipelines, high-conversion outbound engines, and enterprise telematics software.

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Field Sales Automation & GPS Workforce Tracking Software](https://growthtechsys.com/product/field-sales-tracking): Turnkey, zero-hardware field sales telemetry platform with anti-mock GPS beat plan tracking, geofenced selfie attendance, mobile retail order booking with offline SQLite sync, and automated road-distance travel expense calculation.
- [GrowthFlow CRM & Omnichannel Marketing Platform](https://growthtechsys.com/product/growthflow-crm): High-deliverability omnichannel sales engagement platform unifying WhatsApp Business API, personalized cold outreach, multi-inbox rotation, and unified customer CRM pipelines.

## Core Engineering Services

- [AI Automation & Workflows](https://growthtechsys.com/services/ai-automation): Custom event-driven automation engines, resilient webhook pipelines, intelligent document ingestion, and multi-tool internal workflow orchestration.
- [AI Video Creation & Creative Systems](https://growthtechsys.com/services/ai-video-creation): High-velocity programmatic short-form video generation, synthetic voice cloning, automated caption synchronization, and batch creative split-testing.
- [Lead Generation Systems](https://growthtechsys.com/services/lead-generation): Intent-driven scraping pipelines, waterfall data enrichment (Apollo, Clay, Clearbit), qualification scoring, and direct CRM routing.
- [Cold Email & Outreach Infrastructure](https://growthtechsys.com/services/cold-email-outreach): Deliverability-hardened outbound systems, secondary domain isolation, automated inbox warming, and spam-safe sequencing.
- [Website Design & Management](https://growthtechsys.com/services/website-design): High-performance digital platforms engineered for conversion, modern typography, sub-second load times, and ongoing management.
- [Content Strategy](https://growthtechsys.com/services/content-strategy): Compounding thought leadership frameworks, editorial pipelines, organic distribution architecture, and multi-channel asset repurposing.
- [Software Development & Custom AI](https://growthtechsys.com/services/software-development): Bespoke web applications, enterprise dashboards, fine-tuned proprietary AI models, and scalable distributed architectures.

## Analysis & Field Notes

- [AI Video Creation Service for Ecommerce: How to Fix Creative Fatigue Without Studio Shoots](https://growthtechsys.com/blog/ai-video-creation-service-for-ecommerce): Operational playbook for scaling Meta & TikTok ad creative variations from product stills, eliminating studio shoots, and stabilizing customer acquisition costs.
- [Enterprise AI Workflow Automation: Why Most Implementations Fail](https://growthtechsys.com/blog/enterprise-ai-workflow-automation): Practical engineering blueprint tackling structural bottlenecks in off-the-shelf triggers and detailing three production-grade layers for custom AI workflow pipelines.
- [Why Spreadsheets and WhatsApp Groups Fail Field Sales Teams](https://growthtechsys.com/blog/why-spreadsheets-whatsapp-fail-field-sales-teams): Architectural breakdown of operational profit leakages in FMCG and distribution networks, and the technical mechanisms of modern field sales telematics.
- [All Playbooks & Notes](https://growthtechsys.com/blog): Technical essays and architecture breakdowns on AI automation and digital growth systems.
